name: chat-room
description: Synced local coding-agent chats, notification-created coordination rooms, conflict detection, and indexed routing actions.

interface.shortDescription: A local chat room for humans, agents, and Git worktrees.
interface.longDescription: Gives every Git project a local, advisory chat room shared by humans, Codex sessions, Claude Code sessions, subagents, and linked worktrees. It continuously mirrors local CLI transcripts, safely continues supported sessions, creates coordination rooms from typed notifications, keeps worktrees as independent routing targets, and can start an explicitly tagged idle Codex turn.
defaultPrompt: List open coordination threads and path overlaps.
